Who we are

A proper neighbourhood barbershop

Golden Gents Salon is a popular barbershop serving the International City community. We keep it simple: essential grooming for men and kids, in a convenient spot right inside France Cluster.

Regulars come back for the welcoming atmosphere and the professional, friendly hospitality of the barbers, whether it's routine maintenance or a quick restyle. ★★★★☆ 4.2 on Google Maps.
